mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.category_id, a.author_id, a.status, a.audit_remark, a.audit_by, a.audit_time, a.publish_time, a.view_count, a.version, a.create_time, a.update_time, c.name AS category_name, u.nickname AS author_name, au.nickname AS auditor_name FROM cms_article a LEFT JOIN cms_category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.author_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = a.audit_by WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, c.name AS category_name, u.nickname AS author_name, a.publish_time, a.view_count FROM cms_article a LEFT JOIN cms_category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.author_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 4 AND a.category_id IN
#{categoryId}
AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.title}, '%')
ORDER BY
a.view_count a.title a.publish_time
ASC DESC
, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, c.name AS category_name, u.nickname AS author_name, a.publish_time, a.view_count FROM cms_article a LEFT JOIN cms_category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.author_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 4 AND a.category_id IN
#{categoryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 4 AND deleted = 0
